title: Monotonicity of space bounds
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $f$ map Boolean words to Boolean words, and let $s,s' : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$. If for every input word $x$ the machine computes $f(x)$ on input $x$ using space at most $s(|x|)$, and $s(n) \le s'(n)$ for every $n$, then for every input word $x$ it computes $f(x)$ using space at most $s'(|x|)$.
